item.title: Betye Saar believed thrown-out objects should have a second life
item.description: "Explore the visionary world of Betye Saar, a pioneering artist who breathed new life into discarded objects. Tune in to our podcast as we delve into her inspiring story and creative process, uncovering the transformative power of giving second chances to thrown-out treasures."
